- **Task:** task 9730 (triage) on issue #5640 — verdict: **CONFIRMED, still live on current main.**
- **Evidence (fresh, 2026-11-04):** at main `1f2cad10740cd2e6ed3b288dd522e4d0d02a5a48`, exactly six production files carry the `home_dir()` fallback `var_os("HOME").map(PathBuf::from).unwrap_or_else(|| PathBuf::from("~"))`: `pkgs/atlas-search/crates/atlas-core/src/turso.rs`, `pkgs/atlas-search/crates/atlas-search/src/fetch_model.rs`, `.../main.rs`, `.../server.rs`, `.../service.rs` (service.rs lines 50–54 read verbatim), and `pkgs/fleet/crates/fleet-search/src/client.rs` (lines 53–57 read verbatim). The empty-HOME half follows from the same code: `var_os` returns `Some("")`, so the path resolves CWD-relative. This matches the packet's real-binary probe (`env -u HOME atlas-search init` creates `./~/.local/state/atlas-search/service.json`; `HOME=` creates `./.local/...`), and the packet's contrast holds: `pkgs/id/src/commands/world.rs` hard-errors on missing HOME. One adjacent site dispositioned for the fix: `atlas-core/src/local.rs` `expanduser()` also keys off `var_os("HOME")` — the fix task names it explicitly. Note the issue title's "(fleet-search)" seam covers both the atlas-search crates and `pkgs/fleet` fleet-search.
- **Routing:** fix enqueued as task 9732 (helper placed it on queue repo-health-code-shadow for producer promotion). Fix rule per the packet: empty HOME treated as unset; HOME unset/empty fails loudly naming HOME (or resolves the real home soundly) — one consistent rule at all six sites, both shapes pinned by tests.
- **Expectation:** task 9730 completes as triaged; the fix lands via task 9732.
- **Links:** task 9730 · task 9732

One more site in this class inside atlas-core, not in the six listed in the body: `pkgs/atlas-search/crates/atlas-core/src/local.rs:74-82` — `expanduser()` strips a `~/` prefix only when `HOME` is set; with HOME unset the literal `~/...` string passes through unchanged (a CWD-relative path when used), and with `HOME=""` it joins the rest onto an empty base (also CWD-relative). - **Task:** Adding independent end-to-end verification for the fleet-search site named above (`pkgs/fleet/crates/fleet-search/src/client.rs:53`), gathered this run on the laptop with the installed `fleet` binary (scratch `/tmp/probe-search-home`, laptop primary @102bfa62ba):
  - HOME unset, clean CWD: `fleet search probequery --via-service` → token error names the literal relative path `~/.config/atlas-search/client.json`.
  - HOME unset, planted `./~/.config/atlas-search/client.json` (`{"token": "PROBE-PLANTED-TOKEN"}`): the token was **loaded and submitted** to the live service — `service at http://127.0.0.1:18760 rejected the job submit: HTTP 401 (unauthorized: invalid client token)`. A CWD-planted file became the client's bearer credential.
  - HOME empty, clean CWD: token error names `.config/atlas-search/client.json` (plain CWD-relative); planted `./.config/atlas-search/client.json` was likewise loaded and submitted (401).
  - HOME unset, planted `./~/.local/state/atlas-search/service.json`, no routing flag: search went **straight to standalone**; the identical clean-CWD control attempted via-service first — the planted marker flips the Q3 seat routing.
- **Expectation:** no new work from this note — this issue already holds the fix; the evidence above pins the transmitted-credential impact for the fleet-search consumer specifically.
- **Links:** duplicate issue #5918 (closed), its packet was task 9806 (cancelled as duplicate)

  All 6 original production sites plus 3 additional sites in this repo carry the unhandled missing/empty `HOME` fallback pattern `var_os("HOME").map(PathBuf::from).unwrap_or_else(|| PathBuf::from("~"))` resolving paths CWD-relative:

  7. `pkgs/fleet/crates/fleet-search/src/server.rs:207` (`default_service_config_path`)
  8. `pkgs/fleet/crates/fleet-search/src/serve.rs:159` (`home_dir`, `resolve_model_dir`)
  9. `pkgs/atlas-search/crates/atlas-core/src/local.rs:76` (`expanduser`)
